# Introduction

Script for evaluation of ClustoCell's clustering of pbmc3k.

# Function Defintion

We first define some helper functions.

```{r}

# Personalized Theme function

styled_theme <- function(
  style = c("academic", "minimal", "modern", "dark", "classic", "void"),
  border_mode = c("default", "all", "none"),
  title_align = c("center", "left", "right"),
  legends_to_drop = NULL,
  axes_title_drop = FALSE,
  legend_position = c("default", "top", "bottom", "left", "right", "inside"),
  axis_title_face = c("regular", "bold"),
  x_axis_text_angle = 45,
  x_axis_text_y = -0.3,
  remove_margin = c("none", "bottom", "all", "top", "left", "right")
) {
  style <- match.arg(style)
  border_mode <- match.arg(border_mode)
  title_align <- match.arg(title_align)
  legend_position <- match.arg(legend_position)
  axis_title_face <- match.arg(axis_title_face)
  remove_margin <- match.arg(remove_margin)

  base_font <- "Helvetica"
  align_map <- c(left = 0, center = 0.5, right = 1)
  hjust_val <- align_map[title_align]
  thin_size <- 0.3  

  # Decide axis title face
  axis_face_val <- ifelse(axis_title_face == "bold", "bold", "plain")

  # Base theme selection
  if (style == "void") {
    theme_out <- theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),  
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),  
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "academic") {
    theme_out <- theme_minimal(base_size = 14, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = hjust_val),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = hjust_val, color = "grey30"),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 1, color = "grey40"),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val, size = 13),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey80", size = thin_size),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "minimal") {
    theme_out <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        legend.position = "none",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic")
      )
  } else if (style == "modern") {
    theme_out <- theme_light(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey80", linetype = "dashed", size = thin_size),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "dark") {
    theme_out <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey30", size = thin_size),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, color = "white", hjust = hjust_val),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey80", hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "white"),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "white", face = axis_face_val),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "white"),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "white", face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "white", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "classic") {
    theme_out <- theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  }

  # Apply border mode
  if (border_mode == "all") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = thin_size))
  } else if (border_mode == "none") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(panel.border = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank())
  }

  # Drop axes titles if requested
  if (axes_title_drop) {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank())
  }

  # Override x-axis text angle and vertical position
  theme_out <- theme_out + theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = x_axis_text_angle,
      vjust = 1,
      hjust = 1,
      margin = margin(t = x_axis_text_y)
    )
  )

  # Handle margin removal
  if (remove_margin == "all") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "top") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "bottom") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(b = 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "left") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(l = 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "right") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(r = 0))
  }
  # if "none", do nothing

  # Legend positioning override
  if (legend_position != "default") {
    if (legend_position == "inside") {
      theme_out <- theme_out + theme(
        legend.position = c(0.98, 0.98),
        legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
        legend.direction = "vertical"
      )
    } else {
      horiz <- legend_position %in% c("top", "bottom")
      theme_out <- theme_out + theme(
        legend.position = legend_position,
        legend.direction = if (horiz) "horizontal" else "vertical"
      )
    }
  }

  # Return theme + guides if needed
  if (!is.null(legends_to_drop)) {
    drop_list <- lapply(legends_to_drop, function(x) "none")
    names(drop_list) <- legends_to_drop
    return(list(theme_out, guides(.list = drop_list)))
  } else {
    return(theme_out)
  }
}

# Label plot
label_plt <- function(label = "Label", size = 1) {
  ggplot(data.frame(x = 1, y = 1), aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    # Draw a single vertical bar
    geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "lightgrey", color = "black") +
    # Add vertical text (angle=90)
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = 0.5, label = label, size = size,
             angle = 90, size = 6, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5) +
    # Remove all extra space
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    theme_void(base_size = 14) +             # no axes, ticks, labels
    theme(
        plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),      # remove outside margins
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),         # remove panel padding
        plot.background = element_blank(),     # no background
        panel.background = element_blank()
    )
}

# Min-Max Normalize function
min_max_norm <- function(x) {
  min_val <- min(x)
  max_val <- max(x)
  if (max_val > min_val) {
    return((x - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
  } else {
    return(rep(0, length(x)))
  }
}
```

# Data preparation

## PBMC3K

```{r}

library(patchwork)
library(scplotter)

# SeuratData::InstallData("pbmc3k")
pbmc <- SeuratData::LoadData("pbmc3k")
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(pbmc))
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc_ClustoCell <- clustoCell(data = pbmc, high_quantile = 0.25, low_quantile = 0.25, subset_to_HVG = F, seed = 121)
pbmc <- addClustoData(obj = pbmc, clustoCell = pbmc_ClustoCell, major_cluster_name = "ClustoCell", sub_cluster_name = "SubClustoCell")

#____________________________________

pbmc$manual_annot <- pbmc$seurat_annotations

pbmc@meta.data <- pbmc@meta.data %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(major_manual_cellTypes = case_when(
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("Naive CD4 T", "Memory CD4 T") ~ "CD4 T",
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("B") ~ "B",
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("CD8 T", "NK") ~ "CL",
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("CD14+ Mono", "FCGR3A+ Mono", "DC") ~ "MNP",
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("Platelet") ~ "PLT",
    .default = NA
  ))

pbmc$major_manual_cellTypes <- factor(pbmc$major_manual_cellTypes, levels = c("CD4 T", "B", "CL", "MNP", "PLT"))

### Manual annotations

pbmc$manual_annot <- as.character(pbmc$manual_annot)
pbmc$manual_annot <- factor(pbmc$manual_annot, levels = rev(c("Naive CD4 T", "Memory CD4 T", "B", "CD8 T", "NK", "CD14+ Mono", "FCGR3A+ Mono", "DC", "Platelet")))

```

# First row

```{r}

pbmc_original_umap <- CellDimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group_by = "manual_annot", label = F, pt_size = 0.0000000001, 
                                        theme = "theme_blank", xlab = "", ylab = "", raster = F,
                                        legend.position = "right", legend.direction = "vertical", palette = "npg") +
  # Add coord_fixed to remove internal axis padding (no expansion around UMAP points)
  coord_fixed(clip = "off", expand = FALSE) +  
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(face = "italic", size = 9),
    text = element_text(size = 8),
    title = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    # Remove outer white space around entire plot (top, right, bottom, left)
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 5, 0),
    legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 2, b = 0, l = 2),      # Internal legend padding
    legend.box.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 2, b = 0, l = 2),  # External space to plot (keep slight right for legend fit)
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
    legend.key.width = unit(0, "pt"),  # Minimize space between point and text
    legend.text.align = 0,
    legend.key.spacing.y = unit(-5, "pt")
  ) +
  labs(color = NULL, x = NULL, y = NULL, tag = "a") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2))) 


#____________________________________

    legend.box.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 2),  # External space to plot (keep slight right for legend fit)

    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
```

# Second row

```{r}

# Finding concordance of major clusters with major cell types
pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot <- table(ClustoCell = as.character(pbmc$ClustoCell), MA = as.character(pbmc$major_manual_cellTypes))
pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot_maxOverlap <- round(((pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot %>% apply(1, max) %>% sum())/ncol(pbmc))*100)

pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot <- table(ClustoCell = as.character(pbmc$ClustoCell), MA = as.character(pbmc$manual_annot))
pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot <- pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot[-which(rowSums(pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot) == 0),]

pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot <- as.data.frame(pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot)
colnames(pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot) <- c("ClustoCell", "Manual Annotations", "Count")
pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot <- pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot %>%
  mutate(ClustoCell = as.character(ClustoCell))

pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot$`Manual Annotations` <- as.character(pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot$`Manual Annotations`)

pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot$`Manual Annotations` <- factor(pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot$`Manual Annotations`, levels = c("Naive CD4 T", "Memory CD4 T", "B", "CD8 T", "NK", "CD14+ Mono", "FCGR3A+ Mono", "DC", "Platelet"))

# ---- add colored x-axis tiles
pbmc_ManualAnnot_cat_df <- pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot |>
  distinct(`Manual Annotations`) |>
  mutate(`Manual Annotations` = factor(levels(`Manual Annotations`), 
                                       levels = levels(`Manual Annotations`))) %>% 
  mutate(color = rev(plotthis::palette_list$npg[1:9]))

pbmc_Major_ManualAnnot_cat_df <- pbmc_ManualAnnot_cat_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(major_manual_cellTypes = case_when(
    as.character(`Manual Annotations`) %in% c("Naive CD4 T", "Memory CD4 T") ~ "CD4 T",
    as.character(`Manual Annotations`) %in% c("B") ~ "B",
    as.character(`Manual Annotations`) %in% c("CD8 T", "NK") ~ "CL",
    as.character(`Manual Annotations`) %in% c("CD14+ Mono", "FCGR3A+ Mono", "DC") ~ "MNP",
    as.character(`Manual Annotations`) %in% c("Platelet") ~ "PLT"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(color = case_when(
    major_manual_cellTypes == "CD4 T" ~ paletteer::paletteer_d("fishualize::Acanthurus_sohal")[1],
    major_manual_cellTypes == "B" ~ paletteer::paletteer_d("fishualize::Acanthurus_sohal")[4],
    major_manual_cellTypes == "CL" ~ paletteer::paletteer_d("fishualize::Acanthurus_sohal")[3],
    major_manual_cellTypes == "MNP" ~ paletteer::paletteer_d("fishualize::Acanthurus_sohal")[2],
    major_manual_cellTypes == "PLT" ~ paletteer::paletteer_d("fishualize::Acanthurus_sohal")[5]
  ))   

pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot_plt <- ggplot(pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot, 
                                             aes(x = `Manual Annotations`, 
                                                 y = ClustoCell, color = Count)) +
  geom_point(size = log10(pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot$Count)/1.5) +
  # geom_text(aes(label = Count)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "white", high = scales::muted("#DC0000FF")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(y = "ClustoCell", 
       title = NULL,
       subtitle = paste0(paste0("Concordance: ",
                         pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot_maxOverlap,
                         '%'), "\nMismatches (n = 81)")) +
  styled_theme(legend_position = "right", style = "classic", title_align = "left", border_mode = "all", legends_to_drop = "size") +
  theme(axis.text.y  = element_blank(),   # hide text
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(size = 7),
        title = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, vjust = -1),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.tag = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),      # Internal legend padding
        legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 5),  # External space to plot
        legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.25, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm")) +
  
  geom_tile(
    data = pbmc_ManualAnnot_cat_df,
    aes(x = `Manual Annotations`, y = -0.5, fill = color),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    height = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_fill_identity(guide = "none") +                    # use literal colors for strip
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.6)) +  # leave space at bottom
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")  +      # prevent clipping of strip
  
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +                             # <- start fresh
  
  geom_tile(
    data = pbmc_Major_ManualAnnot_cat_df,
    aes(x = `Manual Annotations`, y = -1.26, fill = color),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    height = 0.6
  ) +

  scale_fill_identity(guide = "none") +                    # use literal colors for strip
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.6)) +  # leave space at bottom
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")  +      # prevent clipping of strip
  coord_flip() +
  labs(tag = "c") +
  guides(
    color = guide_colorbar(
      barheight = 3    # height of the colorbar (in cm by default)
    )
  )

pbmc$Discordant_ClustoCell_major_manual_cellTypes <- paste(
  pbmc$ClustoCell, pbmc$major_manual_cellTypes, sep = "_"

                                                            "C1_CL" ~ NA, 
                                                            "C2_B" ~ NA, 
                                                            "C3_CD4 T" ~ NA,

                                                            "C4_B" ~ NA, 
                                                            "C4_CD4 T" ~ NA, 
                                                            "C4_PLT" ~ NA,
                                                            "C2_NA" ~ NA,
                                                            "Quiescent_NA" ~ NA,
                                                            .default = Discordant_ClustoCell_major_above10_manual_cellTypes)
)

pbmc$Discordant_ClustoCell_major_above10_manual_cellTypes[is.na(pbmc$Discordant_ClustoCell_major_above10_manual_cellTypes)] <- "Other"

pbmc$Discordant_ClustoCell_major_above10_manual_cellTypes <- factor(
  pbmc$Discordant_ClustoCell_major_above10_manual_cellTypes,
  levels = c("C1_CD4 T", "C3_CL", "C1_NA", "C3_NA", "C4_NA", "Other")
)

pbmc_major_discordance_umap <- CellDimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group_by = c("Discordant_ClustoCell_major_above10_manual_cellTypes"), 
                                       label = F, pt_size = 0.000001, 
                                       highlight = colnames(pbmc)[pbmc$Discordant_ClustoCell_major_above10_manual_cellTypes != "Other"], 
                                       highlight_alpha = 1,
                                       highlight_size = 0.15,
                                       highlight_color = "black",
                                       highlight_stroke = 0.2,
                                       theme = "theme_blank", xlab = "", ylab = "", raster = F,
                                       legend.position = "right", legend.direction = "vertical", palette = "igv") +
  # Add coord_fixed to remove internal axis padding (no expansion around UMAP points)
  coord_fixed(clip = "off", expand = FALSE) +  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#612A79FF", "#33CC00FF", "#AE1F63FF", "#5050FFFF", "#CC9900FF", "#A9A9A9FF")) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(face = "italic", size = 9),
    text = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    title = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    # Remove outer white space around entire plot (top, right, bottom, left)
    plot.margin = margin(0, -10, 0, -15),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 5, 0),      # Internal legend padding
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 5),  # External space to plot (keep slight right for legend fit)
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
    legend.key.width = unit(0, "pt"),  # Minimize space between point and text
    legend.text.align = 0,
    legend.key.spacing.y = unit(-5, "pt")
  ) +
  labs(color = NULL, x = NULL, y = NULL, title = NULL, subtitle = NULL, tag = "e") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 6, byrow = F, override.aes = list(size = 2))) 

#__________________________________________________________________________

# Combine plots

pbmc_second_row <- (
   pbmc_ClustoCell_vs_ManualAnnot_plt + 
    ((wrap_elements(Discordant_ClustoCell_major_manual_cellTypes_tbl_plt +
    Discordant_ClustoCell_major_manual_cellTypes_NA_tbl_plt)) + labs(tag = "d") + theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold", vjust = -0.5))) +
    pbmc_major_discordance_umap
) + 
  plot_layout(widths = c(9, 10, 11), heights = 1, guides = "keep")


ggsave(filename = "../../Testing results/pbmc3k/Final/pbmc_second_row.png",
```

```{r}
## ClustoCell C1 is of type CD4 T

## ClustoCell C3 is of type CL

## ClustoCell C1 is of type NA

## ClustoCell C4 is of type NA
pbmc_C4_NA <- colnames(pbmc)[which(is.na(pbmc$major_manual_cellTypes) & pbmc$ClustoCell == "C4")]

                                           desired_cells = list("C1_CD4 T" = pbmc_C1_CD4_T,

                                                                "C1_NA" = pbmc_C1_NA,

                                                                "C4_NA" = pbmc_C4_NA))

pbmc_major_discordance_typoClust_df <- rbind(
  ((pbmc_major_discordance_typoClust$cell_types$`C1_CD4 T` %>% dplyr::select(CellType, Combined_Count, Avg_Pos_Purity, Combined_Score) %>% dplyr::slice(1)) %>% cbind(Cluster = "C1_CD4 T")),
  ((pbmc_major_discordance_typoClust$cell_types$C3_CL %>% dplyr::select(CellType, Combined_Count, Avg_Pos_Purity, Combined_Score) %>% dplyr::slice(1)) %>% cbind(Cluster = "C3_CL")),
  ((pbmc_major_discordance_typoClust$cell_types$C1_NA %>% dplyr::select(CellType, Combined_Count, Avg_Pos_Purity, Combined_Score) %>% dplyr::slice(1)) %>% cbind(Cluster = "C1_NA")),
  ((pbmc_major_discordance_typoClust$cell_types$C3_NA %>% dplyr::select(CellType, Combined_Count, Avg_Pos_Purity, Combined_Score) %>% dplyr::slice(1)) %>% cbind(Cluster = "C3_NA")),
  ((pbmc_major_discordance_typoClust$cell_types$C4_NA %>% dplyr::select(CellType, Combined_Count, Avg_Pos_Purity, Combined_Score) %>% dplyr::slice(1)) %>% cbind(Cluster = "C4_NA"))

)

pbmc_major_discordance_typoClust_combScore_vis <- 
ggplot(pbmc_major_discordance_typoClust_df, 
       aes(x = reorder(Cluster, Combined_Score))) +
  geom_col(aes(y = Combined_Score, fill = CellType),
           width = 0.6, color = "black", alpha = 0.9, linewidth = 0.1) +
  # geom_point(aes(y = Avg_Pos_Purity * max(Combined_Score), color = CellType, size = Avg_Pos_Purity),
  #            size = 3, shape = 21, stroke = 1.2, fill = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(y = Combined_Score, label = round(Combined_Score)), 
            vjust = -0.8, size = 2) +
  # geom_text(aes(y = Avg_Pos_Purity * max(Combined_Score),
  #               label = paste0(round(Avg_Pos_Purity * 100), "%")),
  #           vjust = -1.5, size = 1.8, color = "gray20", fontface = "italic") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#CDEE40FF", "#8BD4F7FF", "#E96C0CFF", "#8BD4F7FF", "#8BD4F7FF"), name = NULL) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#CDEE40FF", "#8BD4F7FF", "#E96C0CFF", "#8BD4F7FF", "#8BD4F7FF"), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(
  name = "Combined Score", labels = label_number(scale_cut = cut_short_scale(), accuracy = 1)
  # sec.axis = sec_axis(
  #   ~ . / max(pbmc_major_discordance_typoClust_df$Combined_Score),
  #   name = "Average Purity",
  #   labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  #   )
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(pbmc_major_discordance_typoClust_df$Combined_Score))) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL,
    x = NULL, tag = "g"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, vjust = 1.2, face = "plain", color = "black", size = 5.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "italic", size = 6),
    text = element_text(size = 6),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    title = element_text(size = 8),
    # Remove outer white space around entire plot (top, right, bottom, left)
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),      # Zeroed out
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),  # Zeroed out
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
    legend.key.width = unit(10, "pt"),  # Minimize space between point and text
    legend.key.height = unit(10, "pt"),  # Minimize space between point and text
    legend.text.align = 0,
    legend.key.spacing.y = unit(0, "pt"),
    plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "mm")
  
  )

pbmc_third_row <- (
    (wrap_elements(pbmc_pbmc_major_discordance_tbl_combined_plt) + 
       labs(tag = "f") + 
       theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold", vjust = -0.5))
```
